task.description:
CODE-DESIGNER Step 2 (REWORK 1) — revise the design artefact for ISS-0085 / GOV-01.

The previous design at src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md failed lint with 3 MAJOR findings:

1. [E010] Missing required section header for `errors` (expected one of: 'error taxonomy', 'errors', 'error cases'). Add a top-level section titled 'Errors' (or 'Error taxonomy') that enumerates how each consumer reacts when a malformed platform scenario is loaded (e.g. malformed platform_workflow, missing evidence on system_state, via: system in gui uat_surface, actor-system-* on a gui step).

2. [E050] Fenced code block at line 324 exceeds 40 lines. Replace the long fenced code with prose, OR split it into multiple shorter blocks (each <= 40 lines). Same for the block at line 597.

3. [E050] Fenced code block at line 597 exceeds 40 lines. Same fix.

Re-run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md after edits — must exit 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR.

The existing 13 edits across 6 consumer docs (UAT_RUNNER.md x5, PRODUCT_OWNER.md x3, ORCHESTRATOR.md x1, WF-05_uat_run.md x3, WF-06_scenario_authoring.md x2, CLAUDE.md x1) remain valid and should NOT be removed. Only the structural defects above need to be fixed.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md exists and covers all 5 consumers from §7
Design has a top-level 'Errors' (or 'Error taxonomy') section
All fenced code blocks are <= 40 lines
python tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR
Each edit has anchor + before/after + rationale
Hard constraints from addendum §3 and §4 are preserved
Three BO-* docs are NOT touched

result.summary: Reworked design to address lint_design_artefact.py MAJOR findings: added a top-level Errors section enumerating UAT-RUNNER / PRODUCT-OWNER / ORCH / WF-05 reactions to malformed platform scenarios (E010); split the Step-3 system-step text from a fenced block to prose; split the Edit 1.4 schema validation snippet into two passes each under 40 lines; rewrote the §8e UAT-Ready gate prose without a fenced block. All 13 consumer edits across UAT_RUNNER.md / PRODUCT_OWNER.md / ORCHESTRATOR.md / WF-05_uat_run.md / WF-06_scenario_authoring.md / CLAUDE.md remain intact. Linter exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
